record.paper_title: Ball-Evans approximation problem: recent progress and open problems
record.context_brief: Weak versus strong closure of diffeomorphisms
record.original_question: Let Ω, Ω′ ⊂ R^n be bounded open sets with n ≥ 3. Define Diff(Ω, Ω′)_w to be the class of maps f ∈ W^{1,p}(Ω, Ω′) that arise as weak W^{1,p} limits of diffeomorphisms from Ω onto Ω′, and define Diff(Ω, Ω′)_{||·||_{W^{1,p}}} to be the class of strong W^{1,p} limits of such diffeomorphisms. Is it true that Diff(Ω, Ω′)_w = Diff(Ω, Ω′)_{||·||_{W^{1,p}}} in dimensions n ≥ 3?

evidence.quote: Diff (Ω, Ω′)_w := { f ∈ W1,p(Ω, Ω′) : there are diffeomorphisms fk from Ω onto Ω′ with fk → f weakly in W1,p }.
where Hom(Ω, Ω′)_{||·||W1,p} and Diff (Ω, Ω′)_{||·||W1,p} denote the class of strong limits of homeomorphisms and diffeomorphisms in the W1,p norm.
Open problem 8. Weak and strong closure of diffeomorphisms for n ≥ 3: Let n ≥ 3, is it true that Diff (Ω, Ω′)_w = Diff (Ω, Ω′)_{||·||W1,p}?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 3$ and let $\Omega, \Omega' \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be bounded open sets. Fix $1 \leq p < \infty$. Consider the Sobolev space $W^{1,p}(\Omega, \Omega')$ of maps $f:\Omega 	o \mathbb{R}^n$ with $f(\Omega) \subset \overline{\Omega'}$ (in the appropriate sense) whose components and their distributional first derivatives lie in $L^p(\Omega)$. Define the following two classes of maps:

(i) The weak diffeomorphic closure
$$\mathrm{Diff}(\Omega,\Omega')_w := \{\, f \in W^{1,p}(\Omega,\Omega') : \exists\, 	ext{diffeomorphisms } f_k : \Omega \xrightarrow{\sim} \Omega' 	ext{ with } f_k ightharpoonup f 	ext{ weakly in } W^{1,p}\,\}.$$

(ii) The strong diffeomorphic closure
$$\mathrm{Diff}(\Omega,\Omega')_{\|\cdot\|_{W^{1,p}}} := \{\, f \in W^{1,p}(\Omega,\Omega') : \exists\, 	ext{diffeomorphisms } f_k : \Omega \xrightarrow{\sim} \Omega' 	ext{ with } \|f_k - f\|_{W^{1,p}} 	o 0\,\}.$$

Determine whether the equality
$$\mathrm{Diff}(\Omega,\Omega')_w = \mathrm{Diff}(\Omega,\Omega')_{\|\cdot\|_{W^{1,p}}}$$
holds for all such $\Omega, \Omega'$ in dimension $n \geq 3$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is listed as an open problem in the recent survey on the Ball–Evans approximation problem. While the planar case ($n=2$) and various special situations are well studied, no resolution in dimensions $n \geq 3$ appears in the literature, and the problem is presented as open.

status_evidence.claim: The equality of weak and strong diffeomorphic closures in dimensions n ≥ 3 is stated as an open problem.
